Baseus Cafule Converter Cable USB 3.0 Male To Micro-B 1M -(CADKLF-D0G)
Baseus Cafule Cable USB 3.0 Male to Micro-B Male 1M
Applicable to Micro-B devices such as the Samsung Note 3, Galaxy S5, and a range of hard drives, this USB 3.0 to Micro-B cable features the same reliability shown in our other Cafule cables with strong and durable construction which benefits from high quality braiding with a nylon finish, woven tightly to protect its thickened copper wire core.
Further reinforcement and protection is obtained through the 1mm thickened aluminum alloy casing.

Features:
The Baseus cable allows for extremely fast data transmission. Transfer your photos, videos and other documents at an incredibly fast pace. Uploading 1 GB of files takes just 5 seconds. It also supports 2A charging, and the high quality of the workmanship makes it very robust and resistant to breakage and abrasion.
